Neil Sloane shares the comma sequence. Then thoughts turn to immortal kangaroos leaping through minefields. More links & stuff in full description below ↓↓↓

BONUS MATERIAL
A digital curiosity associated with this video - https://www.patreon.com/numberphile/posts/168587472 (open access)
BTS timelapse of this video being filmed (Patrons only) - https://www.patreon.com/numberphile/posts/168593344

See more Neil Sloane videos on Numberphile: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLt5AfwLFPxWJXQqPe_llzWmTHMPb9QvV2

Neil is the founder of the On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences (OEIS): https://oeis.org/

Some OEIS sequences related to this video...
Original sequence when we start at 1 - https://oeis.org/A121805
Landmines: https://oeis.org/A367341
Numbers where there are two choices: https://oeis.org/A367346
The infinite path (strictly speaking, it is the lowest infinite path, because there could be more than one): https://oeis.org/A367620
The sequence of 0's and 1's that lead to immortality (as we know it so far): https://oeis.org/A399179

History Optional Paper 2 Detailed Analysis | UPSC Mains 2026 | Piyush Sir | Sarrthi IAS Optional

In this session, Piyush Sir provides a detailed analysis of History Optional Paper 2 of UPSC Mains 2026, helping aspirants understand the nature, demand, and overall direction of the paper.

The session examines the questions, important themes, conceptual demands, and the approach required to tackle Modern Indian History and World History effectively.

Key Takeaways
➡️ Detailed analysis of History Optional Paper 2
➡️ Question-wise understanding of the paper
➡️ Important topics and recurring themes
➡️ Analysis of conceptual and analytical demands
➡️ Importance of historiography and historical perspectives
➡️ Role of relevant examples, facts and contemporary linkages
➡️ Answer-writing expectations and approach
➡️ Overall difficulty level and assessment of the paper

snippet.description:
When you start UPSC Mains answer writing, don’t make the mistake of chasing perfection from Day 1. Most aspirants cannot write a perfect answer or complete it within the required time when they first begin.

In this video, understand what to focus on when you start answer writing and why quality should come before speed initially. Learn the right progression: first understand the question, address its demand, structure your answer, and then work on completing it within the required time.

A practical approach to UPSC Mains answer writing that can help you improve both the quality and speed of your answers over time.

#UPSC #UPSCMains #AnswerWriting #UPSCAnswerWriting #UPSC2027 #MainsPreparation #UPSCPreparation #AnswerWritingPractice #UPSCStrategy #UPSCPreparationTips
